notes:
[pass A (hunk)]
- Single structured brief in types.go, sections in the order shipped, review_needed, pool, failed. Met. The JSON key order follows the struct field order in internal/briefs/types.go (StructuredBrief), and the test at internal/briefs/structured_test.go:36 checks it. Shipped entries carry ref, title, PR URL, duration and +a −b (structured.go:65-73). review_needed puts overdue items first; an item waiting exactly 24h is not overdue because the check is a strict `>` (structured.go:104). Failed entries carry ref, class and retryable flag (structured.go:86-91). A run that failed and later succeeded is left out of failed (structured.go:84).
- Receipts folded into shipped, cost only on own key. Met for the structured brief: structured.go:78 sets `CostUSD` only for `own`, so `platform`, `unknown` and empty all omit it. The data comes from `GetExecutionsForReceipts`, which reads `key_source` (store.go:866). The separate Telegram digest is still sent and uses the looser "not platform" rule (defect above).
- JSON payload with `schema: 1`. Met: `StructuredBriefSchema = 1` in types.go, and the round-trip test is at structured_test.go:199.
- Email rendering in formatter_email.go with the four sections. Met: internal/briefs/formatter_email.go:156. Slack/Telegram formatters are unchanged apart from the receipts cost change.
- Gateway routes. Met: internal/gateway/server.go:265-266 registers them on `apiMux`, which goes through `s.auth.Middleware` (server.go:291). Production passes a `*memory.Store` (main.go:764 `var gwStore *memory.Store`, main.go:2944 `SetDashboardStore(store)`), so the `BriefPayloadStore` type assertion succeeds. Stored briefs come from storeStructured, which is called at scheduler.go:182 inside `runBriefWithResults`, and the scheduler gets a non-nil store (main.go:4009). Nothing is stored when the daily brief is disabled, so the routes return 404 in that case.
- Tests. The briefs and gateway tests use a real `memory.NewStore` and a real gateway server with bearer auth (internal/gateway/briefs_test.go:30-41), not mocks. They cover auth, empty store, limit, clamping and bad input.
- Migration. Additive `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS brief_payloads` (internal/memory/store.go:282). It has no down path and cannot lose data. This is SQLite, so RLS does not apply.
- Project memories. The key_source=unknown pitfall shows up in the receipts digest (receipts.go:345) but not in the structured brief. The other two memories are unrelated to this diff.
[pass B (adjacent)]
- **Shipped fields (issue ref, title, PR URL, duration, +a −b): met.** See structured.go around line 66. Executions come from `GetExecutionsForReceipts` (store.go:2402, `status IN ('completed', 'failed')`), and executionDetailColumns (store.go:852–866) includes pr_url, task_title, lines and key_source. An empty title would show blank, but the code falls back to TaskID.
- **review_needed with over-24h items first and a one-line reason: met.** See structured.go:103 and :107. Exactly 24h counts as not overdue (strict `>`), and the test covers that case.
- **Pool shown when known: met in code** (structured.go:116). It is never fed in production; see the defects.
- **Failed section with class and retryable flag: met** (structured.go:84 plus ClassifyFailure).
- **Cost only on own key, omitted on platform: met for the structured brief** (structured.go:78, `== memory.KeySourceOwn`). Unknown and empty are omitted too. The legacy receipts digest uses a looser rule (see the defects).
- **Gateway routes with sibling bearer auth: met.** They are registered on apiMux at server.go:265–266, which is wrapped by `s.auth.Middleware(apiMux)` at server.go:291. The production store is `var gwStore *memory.Store` (main.go:764) and is passed in at main.go:1469, so the BriefPayloadStore type assertion succeeds.
- **Payload stored on each daily run: met** (scheduler.go:182). It is skipped when the store is nil (scheduler.go:209). main.go:4009 passes the store.
- **Migration:** the `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS` is additive, matching the existing migrate() pattern. It has no down path and loses no data. RLS does not apply because this is local SQLite.
- **Memory pitfalls:** the key_source=unknown learning is handled correctly in the structured brief but repeated in receipts.go:345 (see the defects). The other two memories (one redacted, one about the executions-row ownership signal) do not apply to this diff.
